**Needs changes before merge.** The alert reading is well designed and pinned, but the PR head fails two UI snapshot tests and its snapshot PNGs conflict with current main.

**What looks good**
- The alert rule is a single seam in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/status_alert.rs` (`is_alert`), with the three sources the PR lists: the feedback-path message, `cannot …` gate notes, and the refusal phrasings.
- A test pins that a command refused through the real feedback path is an alert, and that a later status retires it.
- A test checks the body-text ink against the strip fill in both built-in themes.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in non-test code. Clippy is clean.

**Local results** (reviewed the head as-is; the trial merge with `origin/main` 010bca6 conflicts on `RECOMMENDED.md` and on `egui_app.png` / `egui_app_light.png`, so it was not merged)
```
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib        : 240 passed, 2 failed, 2 ignored
  egui_app::tests::egui_shell_snapshot_light  Image did not match snapshot. Diff: 1  (egui_app_light)
  egui_app::tests::tool_editor_snapshot       Image did not match snapshot. Diff: 4  (egui_tool_editor)
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test egui_app : 3 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test feedback : 6 passed
cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell    : 19 passed
cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings : clean
```
Run with CWD `crates/ui`. The two lib failures are pixel diffs. The same tests pass on a tree with current main (checked via the #227 trial merge), so the PNG baselines in this PR are out of date.

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge `origin/main` into the branch and regenerate `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app_light.png` and `egui_tool_editor.png` on that tree (`UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`), so the two lib snapshot tests pass. Also resolve the `egui_app.png` conflict with main.
2. Resolve the `RECOMMENDED.md` conflict by keeping both entries.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `is_alert` matches phrasings as substrings (`" failed"`, `"not generated"` and so on), so an ordinary status that happens to contain one of them (for example a file name) would be drawn as a refusal. Matching the start of the message, or the refusal sources only, would be tighter.
- The snapshot PNGs overlap with #213. Whichever merges second regenerates them again.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 67ee2684e527442bacfb445fc438fd1f30ba18fe -->
**Not built - the branch conflicts with current main.**

Thanks for the PR. A trial merge of `origin/main` into this head conflicts in three files, all UI snapshot PNGs. The Rust sources (`mod.rs`, `panes.rs`) auto-merge cleanly.

Conflicting files:
1. `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app.png` - this PR redraws the status strip as an alert; main has also changed this golden since you branched.
2. `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app_light.png` - same: your alert-strip change vs. a newer golden on main.
3. `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_tool_editor.png` - same: your change vs. a newer golden on main.

Binary images cannot be merged by hand. To resolve:
1. Merge current main into your branch (`git merge origin/main`) and take either side of each PNG to finish the merge.
2. From `crates/ui`, regenerate the goldens with `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1` (run the `egui_app` and `egui_tool_editor` snapshot suites), then check that the only visual difference is the intended alert strip.
3. Commit and push (plain push, no force).

Once it merges cleanly I will do the full review (build, touched suites, clippy, law check).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
